title: Validation
description: Did Actual match Expected? This is the entity that operationalizes ADR-0010 (Behavioral Verification is distinct from unit testing) and the AI-output-validation pattern.

method.description: How the match/mismatch was determined. 'unit_test' passing alone is NOT sufficient to close an Incident — see ADR-0010. 'scale_classification_review' is used by the ADR-0027 misclassification detector (project-scale-classifier.ts) — it does not verify an Expected/Actual contract, but records whether the orchestrator's project_scale Decision was consistent with the actual iteration count.

decision_ref.description: If this Validation is judging an AI-proposed Decision, reference it here.

notes.description: Optional human-readable explanation of the validation result. Used by meta-validations like scale_classification_review to explain the inferred_correct_scale.
